list.snippet: Stay Hydrated: Drinking plenty of fluids helps thin mucus, making it easier to clear.
Use a Humidifier: Adding moisture to the air can help soothe irritated nasal passages.
Saline Nasal Rinses: Rinsing with saline solution can help flush out mucus and irritants.
Elevate Your Head: Sleeping with your head slightly elevated can reduce congestion.
Warm Compresses: Applying a warm, damp cloth to your face can help relieve sinus pressure.
Over-the-Counter Medications: Consider using pain relievers like acetaminophen or ibuprofen for aches and fever, and antihistamines if allergies are also a factor.
Rest: Allow your body time to recover.
Consult a Doctor: If symptoms worsen or persist, seek medical advice, especially if you have underlying health conditions.
